mods.name: Body Health System
mods.description:
Replaces the single health bar with localized injuries: every body part has its own HP,
critical effects, absorption and medical items.

releases.notes:
## Body Health System 12.7.1 — Minecraft 1.21.1 (**Forge**)

> ⚠️ **First Forge port — compiles, but has not been tested in game yet.**

Built by GitHub Actions from this tag's source; **download the `.jar` from the *Assets* list below** and put it in your `mods` folder (client and server). This is the **Forge** build; the NeoForge build is in the plain `v12.7.1` release.

- Minecraft **1.21.1** · built against Forge **52.1.21** (that build or newer) · Java 21
- **Known limitation:** Forge 1.21.1 does not let a mod hide the vanilla health bar on its own, so the vanilla hearts stay visible (always full) next to the Body Health overlay.
- Player data uses a Forge capability instead of a NeoForge attachment; offline-player edits go through the per-player JSON file.

Same features otherwise: configurable HUD (3 display modes, drag & resize with **H**), body-part damage and critical effects, absorption, medical items, translated names, server on/off switch.

Built by GitHub Actions from this tag's source; **download the `.jar` from the *Assets* list below** and put it in your `mods` folder (client and server).

### Fixes in 12.7.1
- **Pain sounds** were silent in every version: the sound definitions pointed to a file instead of the vanilla sound event.
- **The game no longer stops at startup**: the recipe advancements used the old `recipe` field, renamed `recipes` in 26.3 (reported from a real run on NeoForge 26.3.0.102).

- Minecraft **26.3** · built against NeoForge **26.3.0.101** (that build or newer) · Java 25
- Server config: `config/bodyhealth-synced.toml`.

readmeSummary: Replaces Minecraft's single health bar with a localized injury system: every body part has its own HP, its own critical state and its own consequences.
